hints.title: Busiest moment
hints.body: The number of rooms is the maximum number of bookings active at any moment.

hints.title: Separate timelines
hints.body: Sort all start times and all end times independently.

hints.title: Sweep
hints.body: Walk through the starts in order. Before opening a room, release an ending time that is at or before the current start.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if intervals is empty: return 0
starts = sorted starts
ends = sorted ends
rooms = 0
endIndex = 0
for start in starts:
    if endIndex < length(ends) and ends[endIndex] <= start:
        endIndex += 1
    else:
        rooms += 1
return rooms
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
